title: Culturing Chlorella Vulgaris and Desmodesmus Quadricauda
author: Jakub Nedbal
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bd6vi9e6

steps.title: Warm growth medium
steps.instruction: Warm ½ SŠ Growth Medium (0.5 g L⁻¹) to room temperature; leave outside the fridge for at least 1 hour or place in a 37 °C water bath for ~10 minutes.

steps.title: Pre‑label Erlenmeyer flasks
steps.instruction: Pre‑label each Erlenmeyer flask with culture type, date, initials, passage number or other required information. Sterilize flasks as described in the Autoclaving Erlenmeyer Flasks protocol.

steps.title: Prepare sterile hood
steps.instruction: Turn on the sterile hood and wipe the work surface clean.

steps.title: Retrieve previous culture
steps.instruction: Remove the previous culture passage from the orbital shaker and bring it to the tissue‑culture room.

steps.title: Dissociate cell aggregates
steps.instruction: Place the culture on a shaker at low power to avoid splashing onto the cotton‑wool plug. Vortex Desmodesmus quadricauda for 5 seconds; vortex Chlorella vulgaris for 1–2 minutes (longer if cells cling to flask walls).

substeps.instruction: Vortex D. quadricauda suspension for 5 seconds.
Vortex C. vulgaris suspension for 1–2 minutes, ensuring clumps are broken up.

steps.title: Count cell density
steps.instruction: Inside the sterile hood, pipette 10 µL of the dissociated suspension into a hemocytometer, count cells (count each cell in D. quadricauda coenobia), and calculate the culture density (cells mL⁻¹).

substeps.instruction: Pipette 10 µL of suspension into the hemocytometer.
Count cells using the hemocytometer; for D. quadricauda count each individual cell.
Record the tally and compute the cell density.

steps.title: Calculate inoculation volumes
steps.instruction: Using the measured densities, compute the volumes needed for a 20 mL final culture: seed density = 2 × 10⁵ mL⁻¹ for D. quadricauda and 1 × 10⁶ mL⁻¹ for C. vulgaris. Inoculation volume = 20 mL × (seed density / measured density). Fresh medium volume = 20 mL – inoculation volume.

steps.title: Dispense fresh medium
steps.instruction: Add the calculated fresh‑medium volumes to the pre‑labeled flasks: V_Ddq^medium to the D. quadricauda flask and V_Chl^medium to the C. vulgaris flask.

substeps.instruction: Dispense V_Ddq^medium into the D. quadricauda flask.
Dispense V_Chl^medium into the C. vulgaris flask.

steps.title: Inoculate cultures
steps.instruction: Add the calculated inoculation volumes of the existing cultures to the corresponding flasks: V_Ddq^culture to the D. quadricauda flask and V_Chl^culture to the C. vulgaris flask.

substeps.instruction: Add V_Ddq^culture of D. quadricauda culture to its flask.
Add V_Chl^culture of C. vulgaris culture to its flask.

steps.title: Verify medium temperature
steps.instruction: Ensure the fresh medium is not too cold; if it is, let the flasks stand on the metal surface of the hood for a few minutes to warm.

steps.title: Return cultures to shaker
steps.instruction: Place the inoculated Erlenmeyer flasks back on the illuminated orbital shaker for growth.

steps.title: Clean hood and sterilize waste
steps.instruction: Clean the sterile hood and surrounding lab space. Sterilize old cultures by adding bleach or Virkon and let sit overnight.

substeps.instruction: Wipe down the hood and work area.
Add bleach or Virkon to old cultures and incubate overnight.
